Class WayangDefinition

java.lang.Object
io.quarkus.hibernate.reactive.panache.PanacheEntityBase
tech.kayys.wayang.control.domain.WayangDefinition
@Entity public class WayangDefinition extends io.quarkus.hibernate.reactive.panache.PanacheEntityBase
WayangDefinition — The unified domain entity for an agentic AI workflow.

This is the single source of truth for everything needed to design, validate, deploy, and execute a Wayang workflow. The entire specification (canvas, workflow, agents, deployment, config) is stored as a single JSONB column (spec) for efficiency.

Replaces the previously fragmented CanvasDefinition + WorkflowTemplate with one unified entity.

Benefits of JSONB storage:

  • Single query returns the full definition — no JOINs
  • PostgreSQL JSONB supports indexing and partial queries
  • Schema evolution is trivial (just add fields to WayangSpec)
  • The definition is always read/written as a whole unit
